content.description: Illustration showing removal of piston stopper bolt using a screwdriver

items.heading: REMOVE PISTON STOPPER BOLT
items.text: Using a screwdriver, push the pistons in all the way and remove the piston stopper bolt.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of two pistons and springs using snap ring pliers

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Remove two pistons and springs from the master cylinder.

content.text: It may be necessary to inject compressed air in the check valve hole to force out the No. 2 piston.

content.description: Illustration showing two pistons with rubber parts to be greased

items.heading: APPLY LITHIUM SOAP BASE GLYCOL GREASE TO RUBBER PARTS OF PISTON

content.description: Illustration showing installation of two springs and pistons with snap ring pliers

content.text: Be careful not to damage the rubber lips on the pistons.

items.label: (a)
items.text: Insert two springs and pistons in the master cylinder housing as shown.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Using snap ring pliers, install the snap ring.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of piston stopper bolt using a screwdriver

items.heading: INSTALL PISTON STOPPER BOLT
items.text: Using screwdriver, push the pistons in all the way and install the piston stopper bolt. Torque the bolt.
